scripts.build: tsc -b packages/engine packages/pele-markdown && bun run --filter @yolo-twice/ui build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/analyzers packages/engine packages/pele-markdown && bun run --filter @yolo-twice/ui typecheck
scripts.dev:engine: bun packages/engine/src/cli.ts stop && bun --watch --no-clear-screen packages/engine/src/cli.ts start --foreground --cwd ..
